command: set -euo pipefail; src=/workspace/entityos-crush-omega; dst=/workspace/oMEGAcV1; rm -rf "$dst"; git clone git@github.com:gschaidergabriel/oMEGAcV1.git "$dst"; cd "$src"; test -f go.mod; test -d internal/omega; echo SOURCE_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD); cd /workspace; rsync -a --delete --exclude='.git/' --exclude='.entityos-build/' --exclude='README.md' --exclude='CRUSH_PROTOCOL.md' --exclude='docs/assets/' --exclude='research/' "$src/" "$dst/"; cd "$dst"; mkdir -p docs/research research/runs research/experiments research/failures research/artifacts benchmarks/specs benchmarks/results dist; cp "$src/docs/entityos/DONOR_LOCK.json" docs/research/DONOR_LOCK.json 2>/dev/null || true; cp "$src/docs/entityos/PORTABLE_CORE.md" docs/architecture-PORTABLE_CORE.md 2>/dev/null || true; git status --short | sed -n '1,220p'; git add .; git commit -m 'runtime: import current Crush harness with portable OMEGA seam'; git push origin main; echo DEST_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo 'TOPLEVEL'; find . -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -printf '%f\n' | sort
